provenance.sentence: Passengers sometimes complain about delays, broken air conditioning or cabins that feel smaller than the photographs suggested.
What seems certain is that the idea of sleeping your way across a continent has not lost its charm.

provenance.sentence: A seat on an overnight train produces only a fraction of the emissions of the same trip by plane, and a growing number of travellers say they would happily accept a longer journey if it meant a smaller footprint.

emission.gloss: emissione, emanazione, fuga, fuoriuscita; eiaculazione, eiaculato, spermatico

provenance.sentence: Sleeper carriages crossed borders every evening, carrying students, families and business travellers who preferred a narrow bunk to an early flight.

A seat on an overnight train produces only a fraction of the emissions of the same trip by plane, and a growing number of travellers say they would happily accept a longer journey if it meant a smaller footprint.

provenance.sentence: You board the train after work, read for an hour, and arrive in the centre of another capital before breakfast, without queues, security checks or a bus ride from a distant airport.

queue.gloss: coda, fila (nel senso di successione di oggetti o individui)
